name: Antonia Köhler
title: EA & Office Op. Lead
bio: Antonia is Executive Assistant & Office Operations Lead at Visionaries, where she plays a pivotal role in ensuring seamless operations. She manages the schedules of our Visionaries Partners and oversees the Visionaries Loft in Berlin Mitte, Antonia also contributes significantly to the organisation of the on-site events and collaborates with Laura on various operational tasks. In her role, she handles a diverse range of responsibilities to support the team's day-to-day activities effectively. Before joining Visionaries, Antonia gained valuable experience as an Assistant and Office Manager at Oceans Apart and Hashtag You.

name: Daniel Fuchs
title: Legal Counsel
bio: Daniel is the legal counsel at Visionaries. His work revolves around all legal aspects of Visionaries, in particular regarding investment deals. Prior to joining Visionaries, Daniel was part of the Berlin and New York City teams of Noerr, a leading German law firm, for more than 4 years and advised startup founders and investors on venture capital and private equity transactions. He studied law at LMU Munich.

name: Isabella Yamamoto
title: Principal
bio: Bella joined Visionaries in 2023 and focuses on early stage B2B investing. Prior to Visionaries, Bella worked at Remitly, a fintech unicorn, and was responsible for launching their business in new markets. She ran the DACH and APAC region and led their expansion into China. Whilst doing her MBA she worked at Accel where she focused on fintech and Open Source companies. Bella was born and raised in Tokyo. She holds an MBA from Harvard Business School and a bachelors from Cambridge University.

name: Johann Butting
title: Partner
bio: After nearly three decades in operating roles across the global technology industry, Johann now focuses on working with earlier-stage companies. He is a Partner at Visionaries, where he supports portfolio companies on go-to-market topics. Previously, Johann held senior leadership GTM roles at Slack, Dropbox and Google. Earlier in his career, he founded, built and sold two SaaS companies in the US. An engineer by training, Johann is passionate about building — whether that’s technology, teams or companies.

name: Judith Dada
title: General Partner
bio: Judith is a General Partner at Visionaries. Previously, she was General Partner at La Famiglia, a European seed stage venture capital fund investing into B2B technology companies that enable or disrupt large industries. In 2024, La Famiglia merged with US-based VC firm General Catalyst, where she worked as Partner. Judith focuses on enterprise and AI-driven business models. Her portfolio includes companies like Personio, Parloa, Orbem, Buynomics and Ethon. She started her career at Facebook, managing Amazon Europe’s product and marketing strategy and Facebook’s VC Initiative.

name: Justus Hagebölling
title: VP Finance & Operations
bio: Justus is VP Finance & Operations at Visionaries and leads various topics in the funds’ finance, legal, operations and tax functions. Before joining Visionaries, he worked as an Investment Manager at a Fintech startup in Berlin, and brings his finance expertise from several years as an Associate Director working in Asset Backed Finance at NORD/LB in New York. He holds an MBA from WHU with a specialization in Financial Management, including international modules at Kellogg School of Management and IIM Bangalore, and a Bachelor of Laws. Justus enjoys spending time traveling and is always in for a good basketball match.

name: Katy Sexton Darby
title: VP Communications
bio: Katy is Vice President of Communications at Visionaries, where she leads branding, marketing and PR across the fund and portfolio companies. Previously, she was Global Head of Comms & Marketing at Verlinvest, where she built the function from scratch and supported portfolio companies including Oatly, Tony’s Chocolonely and Vita Coco. Katy began her career at Milltown Partners, where she was one of the first 10 employees and helped build the firm’s US presence, including launching its San Francisco office. She advised high-growth tech companies, founders and investors on communications, reputation and public affairs.

name: Laura Hofmeister
title: Head of Events, Team Op.
bio: Laura is Head of Events & Team Operations at Visionaries, overseeing all internal and external event operations as well as team operations, including feedback and development processes. In addition, she ensures a seamless flow of activities for Visionaries General Partners, Robert, Sebastian and Judith, managing their schedules across deals, board meetings, and other commitments. Laura holds a bachelor's degree in Business Administration with a focus on Marketing & Media. Prior to joining Visionaries, she worked with Boston Consulting Group and Lufthansa in Munich.

name: Linh Seidel
title: Head of Platform
bio: Linh is Head of Platform Operations at Visionaries, where she works at the intersection of the investment and operations teams connecting the dots between our portfolio companies and LP net-work. Before joining Visionaries, Linh worked in the Finance, Data & Business Intelligence Team at OceansApart, supporting scaling performance analyses and internal processes during the company's rapid growth phase. Linh is an active team member of the 2hearts community team bringing together individuals with immigration backgrounds from Europe's tech industry. She holds a Master's degree from Grenoble Ecole de Management graduating as valedictorian.

name: Marton Sarkadi Nagy
title: Partner
bio: Marton is a Partner at Visionaries and joined the firm on day one. He backs deeply technical founders building companies where engineering advantage compounds into enduring products, across AI, infrastructure and frontier hardware. Before Visionaries, Marton was one of the first employees at TIER Mobility, helping scale the company from zero to more than €100M in revenue. He began his career in quantitative finance at Morgan Stanley and holds a Master’s degree in Mathematical Finance from MIT.

name: Robert Jäckle
title: Partner
bio: Robert is a Partner at Visionaries. Joining the fund on day one, he has since co-led several Seed and Growth investments focussing on various verticals, including Fintech, Compliance, HR, Sustainability and Automation. Before joining Visionaries, he worked as an operator for HeyCar, helping to bring E-Commerce to used cars and in private equity at 3i. Robert studied Politics, Philosophy and Economics at the University of Oxford, where he was part of the University’s Tennis and Ski racing teams.

name: Robert Lacher
title: General Partner
bio: Robert is Founding Partner of Visionaries and an entrepreneur at heart. At Visionaries he has partnered with companies such as Lovable, n8n, Pigment, Miro, Tacto and Pave Space. Prior to Visionaries, he was the Founding Partner of La Famiglia, where he shaped the fund’s history and early vision including investments in companies such as Deel, Groq and Personio. He is also the founder of the fashion platform AMAZE, which he sold to Zalando in 2016. Earlier in his career, he worked at Boston Consulting Group and studied engineering and business at RWTH Aachen, the University of Cambridge, Imperial College London and Harvard University. Robert has been featured on the Forbes Midas List Europe and was named Investor of the Year 2021 by the German Startup Association.

name: Roland Geeraedts
title: CFO & MD
bio: Roland is the Chief Financial Officer at Visionaries. He and his team are responsible for all fund-specific topics such as finance, reporting, fund operations, tax, legal, and HR, as well guiding portfolio founders on financial matters. Prior to joining Visionaries, Roland was one of the first five employees of Moonfare, a fintech startup, where he was in charge of finance and operations. Roland helped scale the company to >250 employees, more than €2bn in Assets, a fully international structure including US operations, and raised over €150m in Seed to Series C funding rounds from tier 1 venture funds. Roland has a background in Transaction Advisory, mainly in the Technology / Private Equity space, having worked with EY for 9+ years in Germany and San Francisco (> 60 M&A transactions). He studied business administration at the University of Münster and University of Auckland, New Zealand.

name: Sandra Tur Mayor
title: Analyst
bio: As part of the Finance & Ops. team, Sandra focuses on fund finance, reporting, and investor relations, while driving AI-powered automation initiatives to enhance the team's operational efficiency. Before joining Visionaries, she supported several departments of Metro AG's executive office and completed a Master's in Innovation & Entrepreneurship at ESMT Berlin, where she did a focus on finance at Imperial College London. Originally from Spain, Sandra holds a dual degree in International Business from University of Valencia and University of North Florida.

name: Venkat Kondragunta
title: Partner
bio: VK is a Partner at Visionaries, and spends most of his time focussing on later-stage B2B investing at Visionaries. Prior to joining Visionaries in 2023, he was working in the early-stage ecosystem in Europe with stints as a founder, operator, and investor. VK studied Economics & Management at the University of Oxford. Outside of work VK plays the drums, can be found chasing down restaurant recommendations in London, and is also a long-suffering supporter of the Green Bay Packers.
